{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 2.00

|gr1= Radio and Chat

|gr2= Custom Radio and Chat

|descr= Obtains custom radio channel's details. if 'customChannelID' is invalid, the return is either the first custom radio channel (customChannelID < firstCCChannel) or the last (customChannelID > lastCCChannel). 'inUse' [[true]] indicates if the channel was made available using [[radioChannelCreate]], [[false]] means it can be created.

|s1= [[radioChannelInfo]] customChannelID

|p1= customChannelID: [[Number]] - [[Channel IDs|custom channel ID]] returned by [[radioChannelCreate]]

|r1= [[Array]] with [colour, label, callSign, units, sentenceType, inUse, {{GVI|arma3|2.22|size= 0.75}} callSignVoN] (see [[radioChannelCreate]])

|s2= [[radioChannelInfo]] option
|s2since= arma3 2.22 
|p21= option: [[Boolean]] - [[true]] to return only channels in use, [[false]] to return all available channels

|r2= [[Array]] of [[Array]]s in format [ [colour, label, callSign, units, sentenceType, inUse, callSignVoN],....] (see [[radioChannelCreate]])

|x1= <sqf>
private _channelID = radioChannelCreate [[1, 0, 0.5, 0.8], "Q-dance Radio", "%UNIT_NAME", [u1, u2], false];
radioChannelInfo _channelID; // returns [[1,0,0.5,0.8], "Q-dance Radio", "%UNIT_NAME", [u1, u2], false, true]
</sqf>

|seealso= [[radioChannelCreate]] [[getPlayerChannel]]
}}
